t: What he had just seen while leading them
a: قَدْ أُرِيتُ الآنَ ـ مُنْذُ صَلَّيْتُ لَكُمُ الصَّلاَةَ ـ الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ مُمَثَّلَتَيْنِ فِي قُبُلِ هَذَا الْجِدَارِ، فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ
p: Qad urītu-l-āna, mundhu ṣallaytu lakumu-ṣ-ṣalāh, al-jannata wa-n-nāra mumaththalatayni fī qubuli hādha-l-jidār. Fa-lam ara ka-l-yawmi fi-l-khayri wa-sh-sharr
m: I have just been shown, since I led you in the prayer, the Garden and the Fire, pictured in front of this wall. I have never seen good and evil as I saw them today.
